snippet.title: Tumbles Updated Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey there Slingers!
Tumbles has been practising his flinging everywhere and has now recorded a trailer for you all.
Voiced by the amazing Jake Bresanello, (Cornelius - Winton's Dad in Bluey) the team hopes you enjoy the trailer as much as we have.

Stout Heart Games

A trailer for the upcoming Foddian game Tumbles, Demo is now available on Steam. Play and wishlist at: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3277320/Tumbles/

14.1.26 Update
Anyone who streams an hour of the demo while using the Tumbles Category on Twitch will be added to the credits. The Streamer that gets the fastest time while streaming the demo before release, as above, will get a Steam Achievement named after them.
